pages.title: College
pages.body: I studied Computer Science at the University of the Philippines Diliman, while also on a DOST Merit Scholarship. I'm the type you'd call BS Org, as you'll see in my affiliations and experience.

Online, that’s me. The origin of this can be traced back when I started watching SAO. The main character [Kiri]gaya Kazu[to] turned his alias to Kirito. Using that same mechanism, I turned [Ae]rol [Dw]ayne Balay[on] to Aedwon :)
